context:
Goal: keep your personal-account pages in git, with nothing private exposed.
Problem (risk): banchi, claude-settings and mailaudit are public repos. banchi's branch `artifact-pages-export` holds 20 copies of pages from your outlook and gmail accounts, and claude-settings `roadmap` holds 18. The export scan blocks emails, keys and secrets, but lets personal facts in plain words through.
Based on (read): `gh api repos/shivinate7/banchi` and `repos/shivinate7/claude-settings` both report public; lint/layout.json's public rule keeps personal data out of commits.
Based on (read): the claude-settings copies are workflow pages: roadmap, waiting pages, plans, and mailaudit page answers (125 json files of answers). The coordinator read the file names, not each page.
Based on (read): your gmail run report (pasted 20:03 CST Nov 8) also pushed copies to `artifact-pages-export` in claude-settings (48209bd00, 8492f61ee, 698cd3c31) and mailaudit (c50ebb9).
Departs from: main — adds other-account page copies to public repos.
Meanwhile: banchi #1084 is held; everything else continues.

options.how: Read the copies and confirm nothing private is in them: https://github.com/shivinate7/claude-settings/tree/roadmap/artifacts , https://github.com/shivinate7/claude-settings/tree/artifact-pages-export , https://github.com/shivinate7/banchi/tree/artifact-pages-export and https://github.com/shivinate7/mailaudit/tree/artifact-pages-export
options.label: Keep them public, after your read

options.how: Delete the `artifact-pages-export` branches in the public repos and revert the copies on claude-settings `roadmap`; a session on your Mac does the branch deletes. Git history on the public repos still holds what was pushed.
options.label: Move them to a private repo
options.lose: The rebuild path lives in another repo.

options.how: Revert the copies on the public repos and keep the registry entries.
options.label: Keep only the registry; drop every copy
options.lose: Those pages have no git copy.

ref: banchi branch artifact-pages-export; claude-settings roadmap at fdb17ab4e (merged by triage 19:09 CST Nov 8); lint/layout.json public rule
reply: Routed 20:04 CST Nov 8 to step artifact-pages-other-account (roadmap 53e5011f0): the copies stay public, after your own read; banchi #1084 is no longer held for this. The lane sends a list of the public copies, which goes on the page as an info item for your read. Your note on making all repos private is logged on the step as a note; nothing starts on it unless you ask.
title: Your personal-account page copies sit in two public repos: keep them after a read, move them private, or drop the copies?
